regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Assisted Driving v1.1 Section 3.2.1 & EU GSR

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall maintain a driver-selected time headway (1.0s to 2.5s) to the lead vehicle in highway and urban stop-and-go traffic. When the preceding vehicle decelerates to a complete stop, the system must smoothly control engine and brake actuators to bring the vehicle to a halt behind the lead vehicle at a standstill clearance of 2.0m to 4.0m and hold the vehicle stationary.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Motorway or urban arterial, lane width 3.5m, dry pavement
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Clear weather, ambient illumination > 1000 lux

decomposition_targets.description: Modulate throttle and service braking to match lead vehicle speed and maintain selected headway
Command standstill hydraulic hold once ego vehicle speed reaches 0 km/h behind lead car

formal_requirements.statement: While ACC_Engaged_flag is true and LeadVehicleSpd_kph > 0.0, ACC_BrakeDecelRequest_mps2 shall modulate deceleration <= 3.5 m/s^2 to maintain distance equal to (VehSpd_kph / 3.6) * DriverSelectedHeadway_s within an FTTI of 100 ms.
When LeadVehicleSpd_kph == 0.0 and VehSpd_kph drops below 0.5 km/h with LeadVehicleDist_m between 2.0m and 4.0m, StandstillHoldActive_flag shall transition to true within 50 ms.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Assisted Driving v1.1 Section 3.2.5 (Auto-Resume)

input_context.user_intent: When the ego vehicle has been brought to a standstill by Stop-and-Go ACC, if the lead vehicle moves off within a stationary duration of <= 3.0 seconds, the system shall automatically release the standstill hold and smoothly accelerate the vehicle without requiring driver tap-on or throttle input, verifying no road users cross in the blind forward zone.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Highway lane or stopped traffic queue
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight or illuminated nighttime, no direct front obstruction

decomposition_targets.description: Arbitrate automatic launch when standstill time is within 3s threshold and path is clear

formal_requirements.statement: When LeadVehicleMovingOff_flag == true, StandstillDuration_s <= 3.0 s, and ForwardPedestrianDetected_flag == false, StandstillHoldRelease_flag shall assert true and DriveOffAcceleration_mps2 shall ramp smoothly between 0.5 and 2.0 m/s^2 within an FTTI of 80 ms.
If StandstillDuration_s > 3.0 s, automatic drive-off shall remain inhibited until DriverResumeTap_flag == true.

tolerances.notes: Stationary hold exceeds 3.0s: automatic drive-off inhibited awaiting driver input

metadata.target_feature: Intelligent Adaptive Cruise Control (iACC) Speed Limit Adaptation

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: EU GSR Slide 11, 22 & Euro NCAP Assisted Driving v1.1 Section 3.1

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall integrate front camera traffic sign recognition and digital map data into the cruise control system (iACC). When passing from a 100 km/h zone into an 80 km/h speed limit zone, the system must recognize the posted limit and proactively initiate deceleration so the front axle reaches the new speed limit boundary at or below 80 km/h without harsh passenger jerk.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Interurban highway with explicit regulatory speed limit signage
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, legible signage conforming to national standards

decomposition_targets.description: Acquire upcoming speed limit sign and update HMI advisory status
Calculate deceleration trajectory so vehicle conforms to new speed limit prior to sign passage

formal_requirements.statement: When iACC_ModeEnabled_flag is true, VehSpd_kph == 100.0 km/h, and DetectedSpeedLimit_kph decreases to 80.0 km/h at DistToSpeedSign_m <= 150.0 m, TargetSetSpeed_kph shall update to 80.0 km/h and iACC_DecelCommand_mps2 shall assert smooth deceleration (<= 2.0 m/s^2) such that VehSpd_kph <= 80.0 km/h when DistToSpeedSign_m == 0.0 m.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Assisted Driving v1.1 Section 3.2.4 & 4.3.4.1

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall utilize forward camera lane geometry and navigation map horizon data to anticipate roadway curvature while cruising at 90 km/h. When approaching a sharp highway curve with a horizontal radius of 300m, the system must automatically modulate cruising speed down to a safe lateral acceleration boundary (<= 2.5 m/s^2), restoring cruising speed upon curve exit.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Curved highway corridor, horizontal radius 200m to 500m
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry pavement

decomposition_targets.description: Compute maximum permissible velocity v_safe = sqrt(a_lat_max * R) and command deceleration

formal_requirements.statement: When ApproachingCurveRadius_m == 300.0 m and DistToCurve_m <= 100.0 m while VehSpd_kph == 90.0 km/h, CurveAdjustedTargetSpd_kph shall calculate v_safe <= 72.0 km/h to maintain PredictedLateralAccel_mps2 <= 2.5 m/s^2 within an FTTI of 80 ms.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Assisted Driving v1.1 Section 4.3.1 (Cut-in)

input_context.user_intent: While cruising in Assisted Mode at 120 km/h, an adjacent slower vehicle (70 km/h) performs an aggressive cut-in into the ego travel lane at a critical time-to-collision of 0.5s. The system must quickly classify the intruding target, abort throttle demand, and smoothly assert service brake deceleration to restore safe following distance without colliding.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Multi-lane high-speed expressway, straight trajectory, lane width 3.5m
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry surface

decomposition_targets.description: Recognize boundary-crossing trajectory of adjacent vehicle before full lane occupancy
Assert service brake deceleration to expand headway gap

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph == 120.0 km/h, CutInVehicleLateralOverlap_pct >= 30.0%, and CalculatedCutInTTC_s <= 0.75 s with relative closing speed >= 40 km/h, ACC_BrakeIntervention_mps2 shall assert >= 4.5 m/s^2 within an FTTI of 60 ms and FCW_AudioVisualAlert shall assert true.

metadata.target_feature: Lead Vehicle Cut-Out Unmasking Stationary Target

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Assisted Driving v1.1 Section 4.3.1.1 (Cut-out)

input_context.user_intent: While traveling in Assisted Mode at 90 km/h behind a moving lead vehicle, the lead vehicle suddenly executes a lane change (cut-out) at a TTC of 2.0s, revealing a stationary obstacle (GVT) in the travel lane. The system must transition from cruise tracking to emergency braking to avoid a collision without requiring manual driver intervention.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Multi-lane divided highway, clear travel lane unmasked
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry asphalt

decomposition_targets.description: Switch from cruise headway following to emergency braking upon target unmasking

formal_requirements.statement: When LeadVehicleCutOutCompleted_flag == true and CalculatedStationaryTTC_s <= 2.0 s at VehSpd_kph >= 70.0 km/h, EmergencyDecelDemand_mps2 shall assert >= 6.5 m/s^2 within an FTTI of 50 ms and FCW_AlarmState shall transition to ACOUSTIC_OPTICAL.

metadata.target_feature: Continuous Steering Assistance & Driver Override Collaboration

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Assisted Driving v1.1 Section 2.4 (Driving Collaboration) & 3.3

input_context.user_intent: While Lane Centering is actively steering the vehicle along the lane centerline at 72 km/h (45 mph), if the driver manually applies a sine-wave steering input to maneuver around an in-lane pothole without using turn signals, the system must allow manual override with an applied steering torque increase of < 2.5 Nm, smoothly blending assistance without abrupt disconnection or fighting the driver.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Fully marked highway lane, width 3.5 m, straight trajectory
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry asphalt

decomposition_targets.description: Blend EPS centering assist during driver evasive input without excessive resistance

formal_requirements.statement: While LaneCenteringActive_flag is true and VehSpd_kph == 72.0 km/h, if abs(DriverAppliedTorque_Nm) exceeds 1.5 Nm during an in-lane avoidance maneuver without turn signals, SteeringCollaborationState shall transition to DRIVER_OVERRIDE_COOPERATIVE and total resistive torque increase shall not exceed 2.5 Nm.

metadata.target_feature: Driver Inattention Mitigation & Emergency Safe Stop

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: EU GSR Slide 15 (Drowsiness/Distraction) & Euro NCAP AD Sec 2.3 & 4.2.3

input_context.user_intent: While cruising in Assisted Mode at 80 km/h, if the Driver Monitoring System (DSM) detects that the driver has eyes off the road or remains unresponsive to escalating hands-off/distraction warnings for > 15 seconds (non-transient sleep or medical incapacitation), the system must initiate an emergency minimum-risk maneuver, illuminating hazard lights, keeping the vehicle centered in lane, and decelerating smoothly to a controlled stop.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Motorway or dual carriageway with delineated lane markings
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight or darkness, operational camera DSM

decomposition_targets.description: Escalate optical and acoustic warnings upon prolonged hands-off and gaze distraction
Execute controlled in-lane deceleration to stop with hazard lights illuminated

formal_requirements.statement: When DriverUnresponsiveWarningStage == 3 and DriverGazeAwayDuration_s >= 15.0 s with HandsOnSteeringDetected_flag == false while cruising at VehSpd_kph >= 60.0 km/h, EmergencyStopManeuverActive_flag and HazardLightsCommand shall assert true within 100 ms, commanding ControlledStopDecel_mps2 between 1.5 and 3.0 m/s^2 until VehSpd_kph == 0.0 km/h.
formal_requirements.postconditions: EmergencyStopManeuverActive_flag == true and HazardLightsCommand == true and ControlledStopDecel_mps2 >= 1.5

verification_test_cases.expected_assertions: EmergencyStopManeuverActive_flag == true and HazardLightsCommand == true and ControlledStopDecel_mps2 >= 1.5

metadata.target_feature: Lane Departure Warning System (LDWS) - Dashed Marker Drift

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: UN/ECE Regulation No. 130 Paragraph 5.2.1 & 6.5

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall monitor visible dashed lane markings on straight roads and gentle curves (radius >= 250 m). When cruising at speeds above 60 km/h without turn indicator activation, the system must detect unintentional lateral drifting at rates between 0.1 m/s and 0.8 m/s, alerting the driver via acoustic and visual warning modes at the latest when the front wheel crosses 0.3 m beyond the outer edge of the line.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight or curved road (radius >= 250 m) with visible dashed lane markings, width 3.5m to 3.7m
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight or good illumination, dry asphalt/concrete, no heavy rain/fog

decomposition_targets.description: Estimate distance to lane edge and lateral departure velocity relative to dashed lines
Issue multimodal departure warning prior to exceeding 0.3 m crossing threshold

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph >= 60.0 km/h, TurnIndicatorState == OFF, LaneMarkingType == DASHED, and DistToLaneEdge_m <= 0.0 m with LateralDriftRate_mps between 0.1 and 0.8 m/s, LDW_WarnState shall transition to ACOUSTIC_OPTICAL within an FTTI of 50 ms before the tire exceeds 0.3 m beyond the outer boundary.
formal_requirements.preconditions: VehSpd_kph >= 60.0 and TurnIndicatorState == OFF and LaneMarkingType == DASHED

tolerances.notes: Below minimum activation velocity 60 km/h: LDWS warning suppressed

metadata.target_feature: Lane Departure Warning System (LDWS) - Solid Boundary Spatial Alert

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: UN/ECE Regulation No. 130 Paragraph 5.4.1 & 6.5.2

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall identify continuous solid line lane markings and provide an intuitive directional warning (haptic steering wheel vibration and flashing optical telltale) indicating the side of unintended departure when the vehicle drifts toward a solid boundary at rates between 0.1 m/s and 0.8 m/s at 65 km/h.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Solid delineated boundary line, lane width 3.5 m to 3.7 m
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry paved surface

decomposition_targets.description: Distinguish continuous solid line departure from intentional lane exit
Trigger steering vibration and directional optical cue on the departing side

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph >= 60.0 km/h, TurnIndicatorState == OFF, LaneMarkingType == SOLID, and DistToLaneEdge_m <= 0.0 m on the left, LDW_HapticPulse and LDW_VisualFlashing shall assert true with LDW_SideIndicator == LEFT within an FTTI of 40 ms.
formal_requirements.preconditions: VehSpd_kph >= 60.0 and TurnIndicatorState == OFF and LaneMarkingType == SOLID
formal_requirements.postconditions: LDW_HapticPulse == true and LDW_VisualFlashing == true and LDW_SideIndicator == LEFT

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Lane Departure Protocol v1.2 Section 3.1 & 5.2.2

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall provide active heading correction via electric power steering (EPS) when the vehicle drifts toward a delineated lane marking at lateral departure speeds between 0.2 m/s and 0.6 m/s at travel speeds from 60 km/h to 100 km/h, smoothly restoring the vehicle to the lane without exceeding 40 deg/s steering wheel velocity.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Delineated travel lane, width 3.5 m to 3.7 m, solid or dashed boundary
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry asphalt, lane edge visible

decomposition_targets.description: Calculate time to lane crossing and lateral offset progression
Command corrective EPS steering torque to maintain the vehicle within the lane

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph is between 60.0 and 100.0 km/h, DistanceToLaneEdge_m <= 0.1 m, and LateralVelocity_mps between 0.2 and 0.6 m/s with DriverHandTorque_Nm < 1.5 Nm, LKA_SteeringTorque_Nm shall command counter-steering torque between 1.0 and 3.0 Nm within an FTTI of 60 ms.

metadata.target_feature: Emergency Lane Keeping (ELK) - Road Edge Prevention

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Lane Departure Protocol v1.2 Section 3.1.3 & 5.2.2.1

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall recognize non-painted physical road boundaries (such as grass or gravel verges). When the vehicle drifts toward an unmarked road edge at lateral velocities between 0.2 m/s and 0.6 m/s at 70 km/h, the system must autonomously intervene via steering intervention to ensure Distance-To-Lane-Edge (DTLE) does not exceed -0.1 m.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Paved carriageway bordered by grass/gravel road edge, friction coefficient >= 0.9
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry weather, no standing water

decomposition_targets.description: Segment grass/gravel terrain boundary and compute DTLE without painted lines
Execute lateral steering intervention to maintain DTLE >= -0.1 m

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph is 70.0 km/h, RoadEdgeBoundaryType is GRASS_VERGE or GRAVEL_EDGE, and DTLE_m <= 0.2 m with LateralDriftRate_mps between 0.2 and 0.6 m/s, ELK_CorrectionTorque_Nm shall assert >= 2.5 Nm within 50 ms to guarantee final DTLE_m >= -0.1 m.

metadata.target_feature: Emergency Lane Keeping (ELK) - High-Speed Road Edge Extended Range

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Lane Departure Protocol v1.2 Section 3.1.3 & Appendix A.1

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall provide emergency lane keeping against road edges at high motorway velocities (100 km/h) under lateral departure rates up to 0.7 m/s, redirecting the vehicle back into the lane and maintaining heading stability.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Paved high-speed roadway with grass verge boundary
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry track, wind speed < 10 m/s

decomposition_targets.description: Counteract high lateral kinetic energy before vehicle crosses verge threshold

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph >= 95.0 km/h and LateralVelocity_mps >= 0.5 m/s while DTLE_m <= 0.25 m, ELK_CorrectionTorque_Nm shall assert >= 3.5 Nm within an FTTI of 40 ms, ensuring DTLE_m >= -0.1 m.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Lane Departure Protocol v1.2 Section 3.2.1 & 5.2.3.1

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall provide autonomous heading intervention when drifting toward the center lane marker (lateral velocity 0.3 to 0.6 m/s) with an oncoming target vehicle (GVT) approaching in the adjacent oncoming lane at 70 km/h, preventing a head-on collision at a 90% overlap impact point.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Two-way undivided carriageway, center dashed line, lane width 3.5m, GVT 1.5m from center line
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry weather, ambient illumination > 2000 lux

decomposition_targets.description: Calculate closing TTC relative to oncoming target and evaluate center line departure
Assert heading correction to redirect vehicle away from oncoming path (zero impact)

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph == 70.0 km/h, OncomingTargetSpd_kph == 70.0 km/h, LateralVelocity_mps >= 0.3 m/s, and CenterLineDist_m <= 0.3 m with TTC <= 1.5 s, ELK_EvasionTorque_Nm shall assert >= 3.0 Nm within an FTTI of 40 ms ensuring CollisionOccurred_flag remains false.

metadata.target_feature: Emergency Lane Keeping (ELK) - Car-to-Car Overtaking Drift Evasion

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Lane Departure Protocol v1.2 Section 3.2.2 & Figure 3-5

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall prevent collision during unintentional lane drift into an overtaking vehicle. When traveling at 70 km/h and drifting toward the driver's side (lateral velocity 0.3 to 0.6 m/s) while another vehicle is overtaking in the adjacent lane at 80 km/h, the system must steer the vehicle back to avoid a 25% side impact.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Multi-lane roadway, center dashed marking, overtaking vehicle 1.5 m from center line
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry weather

decomposition_targets.description: Monitor rear quarter radar for faster closing overtaking partner in adjacent lane
Counteract unintentional steering drift toward overtaking vehicle

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph == 70.0 km/h, OvertakingTargetSpd_kph == 80.0 km/h, TurnIndicatorState == OFF, and LateralVelocity_mps >= 0.3 m/s toward the adjacent lane with OvertakingTargetDist_m <= 10.0 m, ELK_OvertakeIntervention shall assert true within an FTTI of 40 ms ensuring CollisionOccurred_flag == false.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Lane Departure Protocol v1.2 Section 3.2.3 & Figure 3-7

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall detect an oncoming powered two-wheeler (motorcyclist target EMT) traveling in the adjacent oncoming lane at 70 km/h, 1.0 m from the center dashed line. When drifting toward the centerline at 0.3 to 0.6 m/s, the system must execute evasive heading correction ensuring the vehicle profile clears the motorcycle virtual box by > 0.3 m.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Two-lane carriageway, EMT 1.0 m from dashed centerline
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry asphalt, visibility > 1 km

decomposition_targets.description: Classify narrow PTW target and track clearance relative to PTW virtual bounding box

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph == 70.0 km/h, MotorcycleSpd_kph == 70.0 km/h, and LateralVelocity_mps >= 0.3 m/s toward oncoming lane with TTC <= 1.4 s, ELK_PTW_EvasionTorque_Nm shall assert >= 3.0 Nm within an FTTI of 40 ms ensuring PTW_VirtualBoxClearance_m > 0.3 m.

metadata.target_feature: Emergency Lane Keeping (ELK) - Car-to-Motorcyclist Overtaking Evasion

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Lane Departure Protocol v1.2 Section 3.2.4 & Figure 3-9

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall prevent a collision when unintentionally drifting into a motorcyclist (EMT) overtaking in the adjacent lane at 80 km/h (ego speed 70 km/h), steering away to ensure the vehicle contour clears the motorcycle bounding box by > 0.3 m.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Multi-lane road, EMT 1.0 m from dashed lane boundary
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry road

decomposition_targets.description: Counteract lateral drift to avoid side impact with overtaking motorcycle

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph == 70.0 km/h, OvertakingPTWSpd_kph == 80.0 km/h, and LateralVelocity_mps >= 0.3 m/s toward the adjacent lane with OvertakingPTWDist_m <= 8.0 m, ELK_PTW_Intervention shall assert true within 40 ms ensuring PTW_VirtualBoxClearance_m > 0.3 m.

metadata.target_feature: Blind Spot Warning (BSW) Type I Adjacent Zone Presence

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall detect target vehicles residing within the defined left or right adjacent blind spot zones (extending from driver eye position to 3.0 m rearward) and display a continuous visual indicator on the corresponding exterior rearview mirror, escalating to flashing or acoustic alert if the driver activates the turn indicator toward the occupied lane.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Multi-lane roadway, lateral clearance 0.5m to 3.0m
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Day/night, all clear to moderate weather

decomposition_targets.description: Determine static or dynamic vehicle presence in adjacent blind spot zone
Escalate informational visual warning to active warning upon turn signal engagement

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph >= 20.0 km/h and TargetInLeftAdjacentZone == true with TurnSignalCommand == NONE, BSW_LeftAlertState shall assert CONSTANT_VISUAL within an FTTI of 100 ms.
When TargetInLeftAdjacentZone == true and TurnSignalCommand transitions to LEFT, BSW_LeftAlertState shall escalate to FLASHING_ACOUSTIC within an FTTI of 50 ms.

metadata.target_feature: Closing Vehicle Warning (CVW) Type II Rear Zone

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: ISO 17387:2026 Clause 4.1.3 & 4.2 (Type FAV)

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall detect fast-approaching target vehicles closing from the rear in adjacent lanes with closing speeds up to 20 m/s (72 km/h relative closing speed, Type FAV). If the calculated Time-To-Collision (TTC) is <= 2.5 s, the system must trigger a closing vehicle warning on the respective side to prevent dangerous lane change execution.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight highway or gentle curvature (radius >= 500 m)
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Clear weather, ambient illumination > 1000 lux

decomposition_targets.description: Calculate rear closing speed and dynamic TTC = rear_clearance / closing_speed
Emit warning prior to TTC dropping below 2.5 s

formal_requirements.statement: When TargetInRearZone == true and TargetClosingSpeed_mps <= 20.0 m/s with TargetRearClearance_m / TargetClosingSpeed_mps <= 2.5 s, CVW_AlertLevel shall assert LEVEL_1_WARNING within an FTTI of 60 ms.

metadata.target_feature: Driver Steering Override and Driver State Link (DSL)

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Lane Departure Protocol v1.2 Sec 3.1.1.1, 5.2.1.1.2 & EU Reg 130 Para 5.2.1.2

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall prioritize driver steering authority during lateral active safety interventions. When an active LKA or ELK correction is occurring at 70 km/h, if the driver applies manual steering wheel torque exceeding 3.0 Nm (+0.5 Nm tolerance), or if the Driver Monitoring System confirms the driver is attentive and signaling intentional departure, the lateral intervention must suppress within 50 ms without jerky torque transitions.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Solid line or dashed lane boundary, straight track
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, normal driving

decomposition_targets.description: Detect driver intentional override torque exceeding 3.0 Nm boundary
Modulate system sensitivity and release steering control to driver

formal_requirements.statement: When ActiveLSS_InterventionFlag == true and abs(DriverSteeringTorque_Nm) >= 3.5 Nm (3.0 Nm + 0.5 Nm tolerance), CommandedTorque_Nm shall ramp to 0.0 Nm with LSS_SuppressionState transitioning to SUPPRESSED_BY_OVERRIDE within an FTTI of 50 ms.

tolerances.notes: Below 3.0 Nm override threshold: system intervention persists

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: UN R152 Para 5.2.1.1 & Euro NCAP v4.3 Section 2.1

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall provide forward collision mitigation for stationary targets. When approaching a stationary lead vehicle on a straight asphalt road at speeds between 20 km/h and 60 km/h, the system must trigger an acoustic/visual warning if time-to-collision is critical, and autonomously apply emergency deceleration to avoid impact or reduce relative collision speed without false activation during normal bypass.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight high-friction dry asphalt (mu >= 0.8)
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, ambient illumination > 2000 lux, no heavy rain/fog

decomposition_targets.description: Forward Collision Warning (FCW) escalation based on TTC threshold
Autonomous full-service deceleration actuation to mitigate/avoid impact
Suppression and abort of autonomous braking upon active steering avoidance

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph is between 20.0 and 60.0 km/h and TTC <= 1.4s, FCW_WarnState shall transition to ACOUSTIC_OPTICAL within an FTTI of 50 ms.
When VehSpd_kph is between 20.0 and 60.0 km/h and TTC <= 0.8s, AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall assert >= 6.0 m/s^2 until VehSpd_kph == 0 or target cleared.
If AEB is active and SteeringTorque_Nm exceeds 3.5 Nm (evasive maneuver), AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall reset to 0 within 40 ms.

tolerances.notes: Below operational lower boundary 20 km/h: AEB should not trigger emergency stop

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: UN R152 Para 6.5 & Euro NCAP C2C v4.3 Section 8.2.2.2

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall provide forward collision mitigation when following a slower-moving vehicle traveling in the same lane. When approaching a lead vehicle traveling at 20 km/h on a straight dry road with ego speeds between 30 km/h and 80 km/h, the system must issue a warning and automatically command service braking to decelerate the ego vehicle and match or drop below the target speed without collision.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight dry asphalt, lane width 3.5m to 3.7m, peak braking coefficient >= 0.9
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, homogeneous ambient illumination > 2000 lux, no rain or fog

decomposition_targets.description: Calculate relative velocity and dynamic Time-To-Collision (TTC) relative to moving lead target
Trigger multimodal acoustic and visual warning at least 0.8 seconds prior to active brake intervention
Assert service brake deceleration demand >= 5.0 m/s^2 until relative velocity reaches zero or lead vehicle clears

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph is between 30.0 and 80.0 km/h, LeadTargetSpd_kph > 0.0, and TTC <= 1.6 s, FCW_WarnState shall transition to ACOUSTIC_OPTICAL within an FTTI of 50 ms.
formal_requirements.preconditions: VehSpd_kph >= 30.0 and VehSpd_kph <= 80.0 and LeadTargetSpd_kph < VehSpd_kph

formal_requirements.statement: When TTC <= 0.8 s and relative speed exceeds 10 km/h, AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall assert >= 5.0 m/s^2 within 100 ms until VehSpd_kph <= LeadTargetSpd_kph.

tolerances.notes: Below minimum CCRm operational speed boundary of 30 km/h

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP C2C v4.3 Section 8.2.2.3

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall provide automatic braking response when following a lead vehicle traveling at 50 km/h that begins decelerating at rates between -2.0 m/s^2 and -6.0 m/s^2 at headways of 12m and 40m. The system must maintain safety margins and autonomously stop or reduce speed without contacting the decelerating lead target.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight dry asphalt, peak braking coefficient >= 0.9
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, ambient illumination > 2000 lux, dry road surface

decomposition_targets.description: Continuously monitor closing distance and lead vehicle deceleration rate
Assert service brake deceleration matching or exceeding lead vehicle negative acceleration

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph is 50.0 km/h, LeadTargetDecel_mps2 <= -2.0 m/s^2, and headway decreases below 10.0 m, FCW_WarnState shall transition to ACOUSTIC_OPTICAL within an FTTI of 50 ms.
If LeadTargetDecel_mps2 <= -6.0 m/s^2 at a headway of 12 m, AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall assert >= 6.0 m/s^2 within 100 ms until ego vehicle stops without contact.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: NHTSA FMVSS 127 Section III.H.3 & Appendix A

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall provide maximum emergency deceleration when traveling at high highway speeds (80 km/h) behind a lead vehicle that suddenly executes severe braking of 0.5g at an initial headway of 12 meters, completely avoiding collision without driver intervention.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight dry asphalt, level slope, peak braking coefficient >= 0.9
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Clear, dry pavement, ambient illumination > 1000 lux

decomposition_targets.description: Rapid hydraulic brake pre-fill and maximum deceleration request upon detecting severe lead vehicle deceleration

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph is >= 80.0 km/h and LeadTargetDist_m <= 12.0 m while LeadTargetDecel_mps2 <= -4.9 m/s^2, AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall assert >= 7.5 m/s^2 within an FTTI of 80 ms.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: NHTSA FMVSS 127 Section III.H.5 (Manual Brake Application)

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall supplement insufficient manual driver braking when approaching a lead vehicle at speeds between 70 km/h and 100 km/h. If the driver initiates braking with insufficient pedal force resulting in only 0.4g deceleration, the AEB system must automatically boost total deceleration to >= 0.7g to prevent collision.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight dry asphalt, level slope, peak braking coefficient >= 0.9
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry weather

decomposition_targets.description: Calculate shortfall in driver braking deceleration and command supplemental pressure

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph is between 70.0 and 100.0 km/h and TTC <= 1.1 s with DriverBrakePedal_pct > 10.0% but ManualBrakeDecel_mps2 <= 3.92 m/s^2 (0.4g), AEB_DecelBoostRequest_mps2 shall assert supplemental braking such that TotalEffectiveDecel_mps2 >= 6.86 m/s^2 (0.7g) within 50 ms.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: C-NCAP 2024 Appendix O Section 0.6.1.6

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall provide forward collision warning and autonomous emergency braking when an adult pedestrian is walking longitudinally in the same lane at 5 km/h with a 25% lateral overlap with the vehicle front, avoiding collision at vehicle speeds between 20 km/h and 40 km/h.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight flat solid asphalt, friction coefficient >= 0.9
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daytime, natural illumination > 2000 lux, clear weather

decomposition_targets.description: Recognize articulated pedestrian gait moving along vehicle corridor
Execute autonomous full braking to completely avoid striking pedestrian at 25% overlap

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph is between 20.0 and 40.0 km/h, PedTargetSpd_kph == 5.0 km/h, and TTC <= 1.2 s at 25% overlap, AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall assert >= 6.0 m/s^2 within an FTTI of 60 ms.

metadata.target_feature: AEB Pedestrian Crossing Nearside Child Obstructed (CPNCO-25)

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: C-NCAP 2024 App O Section 0.6.1.7 & UN R152 Para 5.2.2

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall provide autonomous emergency braking when a child pedestrian (PTC) emerges from behind parked obstacle vehicles (OV) crossing perpendicularly from the nearside at 5 km/h toward a 25% impact location, mitigating collision across vehicle speeds between 20 km/h and 60 km/h.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight urban road with stationary parked obstacle vehicles on nearside lane boundary
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, illumination > 2000 lux, dry road

decomposition_targets.description: Detect child dummy emerging from behind parked vehicles into vehicle corridor
Command maximum brake force to prevent or achieve maximum speed reduction prior to impact

formal_requirements.statement: Upon TargetOccluded_flag transitioning to false and TTC <= 1.0 s with ChildLateralSpd_kph == 5.0 km/h, AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall assert >= 6.5 m/s^2 within an FTTI of 40 ms.

metadata.target_feature: AEB Pedestrian Crossing Farside Adult Obstructed (CPFAO-25)

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: C-NCAP 2024 Appendix O Section 0.6.1.8

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall provide autonomous emergency braking when an adult pedestrian traverses the roadway from the farside at 6.5 km/h, emerging from behind parked vehicles toward a 25% impact position, triggering warning and brake intervention across vehicle speeds between 20 km/h and 60 km/h.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight paved road with farside obstruction vehicles
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daytime, ambient illumination > 2000 lux

decomposition_targets.description: Trigger emergency braking to avoid collision with fast-walking crossing pedestrian

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph is between 20.0 and 60.0 km/h, AdultLateralSpd_kph == 6.5 km/h, and TTC <= 1.3 s, AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall assert >= 6.0 m/s^2 within an FTTI of 50 ms.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: C-NCAP 2024 Appendix O Section 0.6.2.7

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall detect an electric bicycle or bicyclist traveling longitudinally ahead in the same direction at 15 km/h at a 25% overlap, and autonomously apply emergency braking to avoid collision across vehicle speeds between 20 km/h and 60 km/h.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight flat paved track, lane width >= 3.5 m, friction >= 0.9
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry weather, no precipitation

decomposition_targets.description: Trigger autonomous braking to match or drop below bicycle speed without impact

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph is between 20.0 and 60.0 km/h and TTC <= 1.4 s relative to BikeTargetSpd_kph == 15.0 km/h at 25% overlap, AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall assert >= 5.5 m/s^2 within an FTTI of 60 ms.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: C-NCAP 2024 Appendix O Section 0.6.2.5

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall detect an electric bicycle crossing perpendicularly from the nearside at 15 km/h, emerging from behind parked vehicles toward a 50% impact point, and autonomously apply emergency braking to avoid collision across vehicle speeds between 20 km/h and 60 km/h.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight flat solid-paved urban road with parked obstacle vehicles
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry track, illumination > 2000 lux

decomposition_targets.description: Trigger autonomous emergency braking upon unmasking of crossing electric bicycle

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph is between 20.0 and 60.0 km/h, BikeCrossingSpd_kph == 15.0 km/h, and TTC <= 1.2 s, AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall assert >= 6.0 m/s^2 within an FTTI of 50 ms.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: C-NCAP 2024 Appendix O Section 0.6.2.6

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall detect a motorized scooter crossing perpendicularly from the farside at 20 km/h across the vehicle travel corridor toward a 50% impact point, initiating autonomous emergency braking across vehicle speeds between 20 km/h and 60 km/h to avoid impact.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight flat dry track with farside parking line obstruction
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry weather, ambient illumination > 2000 lux

decomposition_targets.description: Trigger autonomous brake deceleration upon detecting rapid crossing scooter

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph is between 20.0 and 60.0 km/h, ScooterLateralSpd_kph == 20.0 km/h, and TTC <= 1.3 s, AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall assert >= 6.0 m/s^2 within an FTTI of 50 ms.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: NHTSA FMVSS 127 Section III.I.5 & Table 22

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall provide autonomous emergency braking to completely avoid colliding with a stationary pedestrian standing in the forward lane under dark nighttime conditions (ambient illumination <= 0.2 lux) using vehicle lower-beam headlamps only at speeds between 20 km/h and 55 km/h.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight flat asphalt track, dry road, peak braking coefficient >= 0.9
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Nighttime darkness, ambient illumination <= 0.2 lux, lower-beam headlamps active

decomposition_targets.description: Perceive pedestrian target under vehicle low-beam illumination and assert emergency stop

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph is between 20.0 and 55.0 km/h, AmbientIllumination_lux <= 0.2, HeadlampBeamStatus == LOWER_BEAM, and TTC <= 1.2 s, AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall assert >= 6.5 m/s^2 within an FTTI of 50 ms.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: NHTSA FMVSS 127 Section III.F (False Activation Tests)

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall traverse over a secured 2.4m wide by 3.7m long and 25mm thick ASTM A36 steel trench plate lying flat in the middle of the travel lane at 80 km/h without initiating false emergency braking or generating peak additional deceleration greater than 0.25g.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight flat asphalt containing ground-level construction steel plate
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry road surface

decomposition_targets.description: Classify ground-level metallic planar objects and suppress automatic braking commands

formal_requirements.statement: When TargetClassification == ROAD_SURFACE_METALLIC and VehSpd_kph == 80.0 km/h, AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall not exceed 2.45 m/s^2 (0.25g additional deceleration) at any point prior to passing the plate.

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: UN R152 Annex 3 Appendix 2 & NHTSA FMVSS 127 Pass-Through

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall travel in a straight line at 50 km/h passing centrally through a 4.5 m gap between two stationary vehicles parked in adjacent lanes, without initiating collision warnings or commanding emergency brake deceleration.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Straight dry asphalt, adjacent parking lanes 4.5 m apart
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry weather, no precipitation

decomposition_targets.description: Verify vehicle driving path is clear despite stationary obstacles in adjacent lateral lanes

formal_requirements.statement: When ForwardPathObstacle_flag is false and lateral clearance to adjacent stationary vehicles exceeds 1.0 m on each side, AEB_DecelRequest_mps2 shall remain 0.0 and FCW_WarnState shall remain OFF.
formal_requirements.trigger: ForwardPathObstacle_flag == false and LateralClearanceLeft_m >= 1.0 and LateralClearanceRight_m >= 1.0

metadata.target_feature: Camera Sun Glare Saturation & Safe Fallback

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: ISO 21448:2022 Clause 7.3.3 & Euro NCAP Assisted Driving v1.1 Sec 4.1.2

input_context.user_intent: When driving eastbound during sunrise with low-angle direct solar glare saturating the forward camera image sensor (> 80% pixel overexposure), the system must detect optical performance degradation without hardware fault, inhibit autonomous steering/braking reliance on optical targets, transition control to radar-only fallback within 100 ms, and alert the driver via visual telltale.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Open highway or arterial road heading into direct sunrise/sunset
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Direct low-angle sunlight (< 15 deg elevation), lux > 90000 lux

decomposition_targets.description: Identify functional insufficiency caused by environmental optical saturation
Downgrade perception from fused dual-sensor to radar-only fallback mode

formal_requirements.statement: When CameraPixelOverexposure_pct exceeds 80.0% for longer than 60 ms, CameraObjectValidity_flag shall assert false and SensorDegradationTelltale shall illuminate within an FTTI of 100 ms.
When CameraObjectValidity_flag is false and RadarTrackingConfidence_pct >= 75.0%, PerceptionOperationalMode shall switch to RADAR_ONLY_DEGRADED without disengaging longitudinal cruise authority.

metadata.target_feature: Millimeter-Wave Radar Attenuation Under Heavy Rain

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: ISO 21448:2022 Clause 7.3.3 & ISO 26262-4 FTTI

input_context.user_intent: When driving through torrential downpours (> 30 mm/hr precipitation) where water droplets create high radar backscatter noise and signal attenuation, the 77 GHz radar must detect elevated noise floor clutter, suppress spurious ghost targets, reduce maximum detection range boundaries, and prevent phantom emergency braking.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Wet asphalt expressway with surface water pooling
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Heavy rainfall rate > 30 mm/h, spray from preceding vehicles

decomposition_targets.description: Quantify signal-to-noise ratio degradation caused by rain volume backscatter
Compress maximum verified perception horizon and suppress low-confidence targets

formal_requirements.statement: When RainfallRate_mmph >= 30.0 mm/h and RadarNoiseFloor_dBm rises above -75.0 dBm, RadarMaxTrackingRange_m shall de-rate from 180.0 m down to 70.0 m within 120 ms.
While RadarDegradedAlert_flag is true, any radar target candidate with RadarTargetSNR_dB < 12.0 dB shall be suppressed from commanding emergency braking (PhantomBrakeSuppressionActive_flag == true).

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Assisted Driving v1.1 Section 4.1.2.3 & ISO 21448 Cl. 8.3.3

input_context.user_intent: While cruising with Lane Centering and ACC active, if mud splash or road salt accumulation covers more than 50% of the forward camera field of view, the system must detect optical blockage within 10 seconds, issue an acoustic and visual cleaning reminder to the driver, and initiate safe disengagement of lateral assistance.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Paved road with wet slush or dirt contamination
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, road debris accumulation

decomposition_targets.description: Distinguish uniform gray lens occlusion from dark night scenes
Alert driver and execute orderly lateral assistance disengagement

formal_requirements.statement: When CameraLensBlockedFraction_pct >= 50.0% and ContinuousBlockageDuration_s >= 10.0 s while LaneCenteringActive_flag is true, BlockageWarningTelltale and TakeoverChimeActive_flag shall assert true and LaneCenteringDisengage_flag shall execute a controlled 5.0 s torque ramp-down.
formal_requirements.postconditions: BlockageWarningTelltale == true and TakeoverChimeActive_flag == true and LaneCenteringDisengage_flag == true

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: ISO 21448:2022 Sense-Plan-Act Model & ISO 26262 Part 3

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle perception fusion engine shall cross-validate forward obstacle targets between forward radar and stereo vision. If radar reports an imminent stationary obstacle at 25m while vision reports a clear roadway due to camera sun blinding, or vice versa, the system must arbitrate discrepancy, reject single-sensor false triggers, request sensor health validation, and avoid unwarranted harsh deceleration.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Divided highway, straight lanes
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Conflicting ambient lighting or metallic overpass reflections

decomposition_targets.description: Perform spatial and kinematic coincidence gating between radar and vision tracks

formal_requirements.statement: When abs(RadarTargetDistance_m - VisionTargetDistance_m) >= 15.0 m while one sensor probability >= 0.85 and the other <= 0.15, FusionPlausibilityState shall assert DISCREPANCY_UNRESOLVED and AEB_BrakingAllowed_flag shall inhibit emergency deceleration within an FTTI of 40 ms.

metadata.target_feature: Sensor PMIC Under-Voltage Reset & Watchdog Diagnostic

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: ROHM White Paper Section 6-4, 6-5 (BD39040MUF PMIC) & ISO 26262 Part 5

input_context.user_intent: The ADAS ECU power management system shall continuously monitor voltage rails feeding perception microcontrollers and radar/camera sensors. If battery transient draw causes secondary 3.3V/5.0V supply rail sagging exceeding -10% tolerance, the power monitoring IC must assert a reset within 10 ms, prevent corrupt perception frame transmission, and transition the ECU to safe state.

operational_design_domain.road_type: All vehicle operational roads
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Normal to extreme operating temperatures (-40 C to 105 C)

decomposition_targets.description: Independent window-comparator monitoring of internal sensor and MCU voltage rails

formal_requirements.statement: When PMIC_RailVoltage3V3_V drops below 2.97 V (-10% threshold) or PMIC_RailVoltage5V0_V drops below 4.50 V, ECU_ResetTrigger_flag and CAN_BroadcastInhibit_flag shall assert true within an FTTI of 10 ms, forcing SafeStateTransitionActive_flag == true.
formal_requirements.postconditions: ECU_ResetTrigger_flag == true and CAN_BroadcastInhibit_flag == true and SafeStateTransitionActive_flag == true

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: ISO 21448:2022 Clause 3.12 (Insufficiency of Specification) & Cl. 7.3.1

input_context.user_intent: While traveling through a highway work zone with non-standard yellow/black chevron cones and missing dashed lane lines, the lateral path planner must detect lane boundary ambiguity without sensor hardware failure, prevent erratic steering jerks, disengage active lane centering with an audible handover prompt, and request immediate driver steering resumption.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Construction zone with ambiguous, non-standard cones and stripped paint
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, irregular construction infrastructure

decomposition_targets.description: Recognize unmodeled road infrastructure geometries and smoothly hand over lateral authority

formal_requirements.statement: When LaneMarkingConfidence_pct drops below 25.0% and PathCurvatureVariance >= 3.0 in presence of PylonClusterDetected_flag == true, SteeringAssistanceActive_flag shall disengage smoothly with MaxSteeringJerk_degps3 <= 5.0 deg/s^3 and DriverHandoverRequest_flag shall assert true within an FTTI of 80 ms.
formal_requirements.postconditions: SteeringAssistanceActive_flag == false and DriverHandoverRequest_flag == true and MaxSteeringJerk_degps3 <= 5.0

verification_test_cases.expected_assertions: SteeringAssistanceActive_flag == false and DriverHandoverRequest_flag == true and MaxSteeringJerk_degps3 <= 5.0
